# Mission Health 3D assets

All from NASA, free to use (NASA media usage guidelines):

- iss.glb: NASA 3D Resources, International Space Station (ISS) (A). https://github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources
- emu.glb: NASA 3D Resources, Extravehicular Mobility Unit (spacesuit).
- habitat.glb: NASA 3D Resources, Habitat Demonstration Unit (part 1).
- earth.jpg: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation (world.topo.bathy.200405), from NASA WorldWind. https://github.com/NASAWorldWind/WebWorldWind
- earth_rough.jpg, earth_clouds.png: made from the Blue Marble image (ocean shine mask; procedural clouds).
- moon.jpg: NASA 3D Resources, Images and Textures / Moon (cropped to the disc).
- mars.jpg: NASA 3D Resources, Images and Textures / Mars.

../draco/: the Draco decoder shipped with three.js (MIT), needed because the NASA models are Draco-compressed.
